static_traits.name: Lin Anqi
static_traits.social_status: 有支持性的妻子和几位亲密朋友,但尚not yet与他们讨论not安与饮食担忧;Work繁忙限制了社交与情感分享
static_traits.medical_history: without明显躯体疾病;既往without类似心理问题与心理治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,逻辑连贯;语气Anxiety与悲观;对自我较苛责,体验到羞耻与尴尬;总体配合度好,愿意尝试小步改变

basic_info.main_problem: I constantly feel hungry and worry that my eating habits will lead to obesity.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent worry about diet and weight gain has affected mood, energy, and family life, so decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: 几个月前,Lin Anqi的WorkStress significantly increasing,长时间加班与高强度管理职责使其Physical and mental exhaustion,随之出现持续饥饿与食欲上升.她开始担心饮食会导致肥胖,这种担忧在A busy workday尤为严重;下班后和周末更加容易进食过量并感到Anxiety与内疚.她尝试过多种节食与锻炼方案,但因Work节奏难以维持,失败体验进一步加剧了'失控'与'注定失败'的感受.同时,虽然拥有支持性的妻子和朋友,她因羞耻与'怕给他人添麻烦'而have not主动分享相关困扰,造成支持资源not yet被有效利用.

special_situations.event: 繁忙Work日下班后回到家,Physical and mental exhaustion并感到Anxiety,面对晚餐或零食
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I feel intense hunger or eat more than planned, it means I am losing control, and my weight will inevitably go out of control
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Makes strict diet/exercise plans trying to regain control; when tense, eats to temporarily relieve stress
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Once I eat a bit more, I will get fatter and fatter, sooner or later I will become obese

special_situations.event: A week of unusually busy work, hunger and appetite increase
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要压力来了,我的饮食就not可避免地失控
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids talking about troubles with others, toughs it out alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这周肯定会长很多肉,我控制not了

special_situations.event: 因Work打断而not yet能按计划坚持某个饮食/运动方案
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能完美坚持计划,那就等于失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Either go all out executing a high-intensity plan, or give up completely
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我又失败了,说明我根本做not到

special_situations.event: 与家人相处时因饮食与体重Anxiety而Low mood
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我状态not好,就会给家人带来负担,让他们失望
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少向妻子表达真实感受,避免谈论not安与饮食问题

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be understood and supported, while hoping to regain a sense of control over one's body and diet
core_conflict.fear: Fears exposing vulnerability will burden others, be judged, or draw disappointed looks
defense_goal: 通过not表达需求来避免成为负担与Being rejected
以自我控制(严格节食/计划)来压制Anxiety与失控感

object_relations.self_representation: A shameful, possibly out-of-control person who drags others down
object_relations.object_representation: Others who are supportive but may be dragged down by me or disappointed in me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师建议与妻子分享压力与not安,或探询其羞耻感时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equates expressing needs with 'troubling the other person', worrying about being disliked or disappointing one's wife
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气克制而客观,强调'not想麻烦她/她很忙',以讨论事实和安排代替表达感受.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被问及进食背后的情绪体验(如羞耻,without助)时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Views emotional experience as dangerous or embarrassing, believes once touched one will lose control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 转而讨论饮食计划,卡路里或Work安排,use理性分析语气,回避情绪词.

manifestations: not与妻子和朋友分享关于饮食与体重的担忧,担心给他人添麻烦
Tends to bear it alone under pressure and shame
outcomes: Anxiety与羞耻累积,支持资源not yet被利用

manifestations: Long working hours limit self-care choices and life rhythm
A strong fear of 'losing control over body / eating'
outcomes: A sense of losing control and compulsive control swing between strict planning and giving up
Intensified cycle of emotional eating and guilt

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: 反复担心'我会拖累妻子',体验羞耻而not敢开口
In counseling, cautiously evaluates whether each step is 'appropriate', avoiding expressing needs directly

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: 需要支持时选择独自承受压力,not向妻子求助
Deals with tension through eating, guilt, and self-blame rather than connecting outward

positive_force: Has a supportive spouse与几位亲密朋友(潜在Social support)
能意识到部分担忧并not yet成真,具备一定现实检验能力
Willing to try small-step actions and behavioral experiments, motivation and cooperation are good
Has a stable occupation and basic self-discipline ability, providing conditions for structured change
negative_force: Long-term high pressure and overtime cause physical and mental exhaustion, triggering emotional eating
灾难化,预测not yet来,过度概括与个人化等认知偏差维持Anxiety
羞耻与'怕麻烦他人'的信念导致回避求助,支持资源not yet被利用
全或without的控制策略使计划难以维持,失败感与内疚循环增强
Guilt and self-blame about eating in turn increase stress, forming a vicious cycle of 'stress - eating - guilt'

target_behavior.behavior: Emotional eating (eating excessively / frequently after stress)
antecedent: 繁忙Work日结束后感到疲惫与Anxiety
周末与晚间Being alone或放松时段
Unusually busy work causes increased hunger and tension
target_behavior.core_reason: Work压力诱发Anxiety与躯体饥饿体验,并以'会失控变肥胖'的灾难化Interpretation维持紧张,trigger'进食缓解—内疚—更紧张'的循环
target_behavior.function: 逃避not适情绪并获得短暂的安慰与放松
target_behavior.consequence: 体重与外形Anxiety intensified,Low mood与内疚增加,睡眠与自我照料受扰,Tense family relationships

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids expressing needs and shame to the wife / friends (absence of help-seeking behavior)
antecedent: Shame and embarrassment when thinking about discussing diet and weight worries
Worrying about troubling the other person or being judged
target_behavior.core_reason: 以避免成为负担与被negate为核心的信念驱动,羞耻感Reinforcement了自我封闭
target_behavior.function: Avoids possible rejection and negative evaluation; maintains surface control and interpersonal safety
target_behavior.consequence: 支持资源not yet被利用,Sense of isolation与Anxiety维持,进食问题与Emotional distress persisting
